title: achillea foliosa
intro: Achillea foliosa, commonly known as the Yarrow-leaved Yarrow or Western Yarrow, is a perennial herb in the sunflower family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, inflammation, and fever. The health benefits of Achillea foliosa include its antimicrobial, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which help to soothe digestive issues, relieve menstrual cramps, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
